description: RC column backbone curve dataset is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Yifan Fei, Tsinghua University (tsinghua.edu.cn). This dataset provides more than 100 backbone curves of reinforced concrete columns that are collected from Chinese literature. The data could be used in structural engineering or earthquake engineering. The details of the specimens can be found in the spreadsheet and the backbone curves are available in the csv files. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-eppg-5133. Keywords: reinforced concrete column; backbone curve; Chinese literature. Published 2020-06-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
